title.en: AN ACT SEPARATING THE SITIO OF CROSSING FROM BARANGAY POBLACION IN THE MUNICIPALITY OF KITCHARAO, PROVINCE OF AGUSAN DEL NORTE, AND CONSTITUTING IT INTO A DISTINCT AND INDEPENDENT BARANGAY TO BE KNOWN AS BARANGAY CROSSING

text.en:
Creation of Barangay Crossing. - The sitio
of Crossing is hereby separated from Barangay Poblacion in the
Municipality of Kitcharao, Province of Agusan del Norte and
constituted as a distinct and independent barangay to be known
as Barangay Crossing.

2

Territorial Boundaries. - The territorial
boundaries of Barangay Crossing are hereby described
"Bounded on the North by Barangay Songkoy and
Barangay Poblacion;
"On the East by Barangay Mahayahay;
"On the West by Lake Mainit; and
"On the South by Barangay San Roque."

Conduct and Supervision of Plebiscite. - The
plebiscite conducted and supervised by the Commission on
Elections (COMELEC) pursuant to Provincial Ordinance
No. 155-2004 of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan of the
Province of Agusan del Norte, which ratified the creation of
Barangay Crossing as proclaimed by the Plebiscite Board of
Canvassers on October 16, 2004, shall serve as substantial
compliance with the plebiscite requirement under Section 10
of the Local Government Code of 1991, as amended.

Incumbent Barangay Officials. - The incumbent
elected barangay officials of Barangay Crossing shall continue
to hold office until such time that their successors have been
duly elected and qualified.

Public Infrastructure and Facilities. - All
public infrastructure and facilities existing therein at the time of
the approval of this Act are hereby transferred without cost
or compensation to and shall be administered by the new
Barangay Crossing.
SEc. 6. Internal Revenue Allotment Shares. - Barangay
Crossing shall be entitled to internal revenue allotment (IRA)
shares pursuant to Section 285 of the Local Government Code
of 1991, as amended.

3

Effectivity. - This Act shall take effect
fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette
or in a newspaper of general circulation.
